about: Two or three overlapping circles, each arriving as it is named, with what belongs to only one written in its own part and what they share in the overlap: similarities and differences, what two things have in common.

sets.about: the two or three sets' names, split by |

onlyA.about: what belongs only to the first, split by |

onlyB.about: what belongs only to the second, split by |

onlyC.about: what belongs only to the third, split by |

shared.about: what they all share, written in the overlap, split by |

when.about: moments each set arrives, then the shared part; else when they are said, or one after another
